searchText: Who knows if https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/apiSpec/sequencerApi.yml is up to date? It looks to me like some of that spec does not match what I get from seq.ceremony.ethereum.org which parts are you noticing to be different? For instance the receipt in ContributionReceipt: description: "serialized JSON (to avoid unordered keys) with properties: id_token: { sub: string, nickname: string, provider: string, exp: u64 }, g2: [string] " What I actually get: "identity" and "witness" There's also an "ecdsaSignature" in BatchContribution which is not specified (received an empty string as the value) https://twitter.com/aliatiia_/status/1612570208484433920?s=20
